statement: CoreWeave's contracted revenue backlog reached $99.4 billion as of March 31, 2026, up from $66.8 billion in February 2026, with Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic locking in long-term compute agreements.
why: Large customers signing long-term compute contracts convert into committed future GPU and datacenter demand for the neocloud.

impact.mechanism: A rapidly growing contracted backlog signals locked-in future demand for GPU compute capacity.

evidence.source: The Tech Capital / Yahoo Finance / The Globe and Mail
evidence.excerpt: CoreWeave contracted revenue backlog reached $99.4 billion as of March 31, 2026, up from $66.8 billion in February 2026

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting corroborated by Yahoo Finance and Globe and Mail; figure dates to CoreWeave's Q1 print.
